title: Full-suite C40P01 at TC-TNT-01-01 between provisionTenantSchema and concurrent migrations race (different lock graph than ISS-0129)
scope: Out of scope for ISS-0129 (GH #419) fix verification. Filed during 5b re-verification.
symptom: zig build test-integration exhibits ONE C40P01 deadlock at TC-TNT-01-01 (provisionTenantSchema) under full-suite concurrency. Different lock graph than ISS-0129/GH-419.
root_cause_analysis: AccessShareLock on relation 3635649 vs ShareLock on transaction 2054720 between concurrent provisionTenantSchema calls and another connection's open transaction. The advisory lock pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('bpm.migrations.runForSchema')::bigint) from b1fc794 does not serialize open transactions held by provisionTenantSchema callers' sibling connections.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-integration exits 0 with zero C40P01 occurrences in 3 consecutive runs
Fix does not regress ISS-0129 fix (verified by RT-3/4/5 of tests/integration/iss0129_migration_run_advisory_lock_test.zig)

diagnosis_wf03_gh424.confirmed_root_cause: Pre-ISS-0612 provisionTenantSchema() acquired a SEPARATE pool connection for EACH of Steps 2, 4, 6, and 6a (plus runForSchema's own connection), with NO effective serialization lock (the advisory lock scope closed before Step 2 began — see ISS-0612). Under full-suite concurrency (20+ binaries), each binary had up to 5 independent pool connections simultaneously active in PostgreSQL for the same logical provisioning call. The C40P01 lock cycle (AccessShareLock on public.tenant_schemas vs ShareLock on transaction XID) formed between: (a) a Step-2 connection's SELECT scan on tenant_schemas and (b) a Step-4 or Step-6 connection from a concurrent binary performing an uncommitted INSERT/UPDATE into tenant_schemas. The unique constraint on tenant_schemas(tenant_id) caused the ShareLock on transactionid when two binaries raced to INSERT for the same tenant_id (DEFAULT_TENANT_ID = '00000000-...'); the SELECT scan then waited for the first inserter's transaction to commit. A third connection's DDL (runForSchema inside a BEGIN holding the global MIGRATIONS_LOCK_KEY_SQL xact-lock) completed the cycle by acquiring an ExclusiveLock on catalog objects that the concurrent Step-2 connection's AccessShareLock on tenant_schemas had to wait for.
diagnosis_wf03_gh424.fix_description: ISS-0612 (GH-556, commit 2dc07ddf, merged 2026-08-07) restructured provisionTenantSchema() to acquire ONE pool connection (lock_conn) and hold it — together with the session-scoped advisory lock — across ALL of Steps 2-6a. Steps 2, 4, 6, 6a now reuse lock_conn sequentially; only Step 5 (runForSchema) uses its own separate connection internally (required by runForSchema's signature; safe because the lock stays held on lock_conn during Step 5's execution — see ISS-0612 design §3). Pool.release() also gains pg_advisory_unlock_all() as defense-in-depth. This eliminates the 'sibling connections' pattern: with one lock_conn instead of five independent ones, there is no cross-connection lock cycle possible between Steps 2-6a of the same logical call.
diagnosis_wf03_gh424.verification_required: TEST-RUNNER must run zig build test-integration 3 consecutive times and confirm zero C40P01 errors. See acceptance_criteria above.

resolution: Fixed by ISS-0612 (GH-556, commit 2dc07ddf, 2026-08-07). provisionTenantSchema() now holds one session-scoped advisory-locked pool connection across Steps 2-6a, eliminating the cross-connection lock cycle. TC-TNT-01-01 passes with zero C40P01 under full-suite concurrency, verified by WF03-GH424-20260809 TEST-RUNNER (2026-08-09).
